verdict.rationale: Fern is a hosted docs and SDK platform that stores reader activity, Ask Fern questions and analytics, so controlling data retention and deletion is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documented retention settings, deletion controls or data-lifecycle policies. Password protection, visitor authentication and self-hosted containers are adjacent access or deployment features, not retention controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
